title: PHP fixes two critical remote code execution bugs (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619)
altText: Animated illustration with the headline 'Why must every PHP website update today?' and the line 'One bug in PHP reaches every site built on it.' Three website windows, a WordPress blog, a Laravel app and 'Your site', are linked to one box labelled PHP. A red bug crawls onto the PHP box and all three sites show red warning marks. A developer throws a 'patch' bandage onto the bug, a progress bar fills to 'PHP updated, sites safe', and all three sites turn to green ticks. The floor reads 'patch = a small update that fixes a bug' and 'Fixed in 8.5.12 · 8.4.27 · 8.3.36 · 8.2.35'.
